conflicts: Pi 5 ports vs drawing 10: the Pi short edges have only 6 mm (−x, to the key-storage divider x525.74) and 9 mm (+x, to the XH-A232 drawn at x625.74) of room; a USB-A plug + IH190 angled gender + dongle needs ~35 mm. Its long edges have 8 mm (+y, I/O plate y398.5) and ~11 mm (−y, PED board) for the USB-C power plug (C24, ~25 mm). Suggest moving the XH-A232 to the right wall (x660.26-714.26, y334.5-380.5) and the PED board toward the cable entry, or rotate the Pi. Positions here follow drawing 10.

Drawing 10 board boxes are smaller than the purchased parts: XH-A232 drawn 50×40 vs 54×46×14 (BOM L53); buck drawn 61×40 ×27 tall vs 60.8×40.3×29 (power.md); PED board drawn 60×45 vs 5×7 cm (SCH-05); PD trigger drawn 30×16 in front of the plate vs 16.4×10×4.4 in an I/O-plate pocket (SCH-06). This file uses the real sizes centred on the drawn boxes.
KCD1-101A is a snap-in switch for thin panels but the I/O plate is 11.5 thick (drawing 10 side section y398.5-410): the plate needs a ~2 mm web around the 19.2×13.2 cut-out.

USB hub: v3 assembly text says it is taped to the power-bank bay back wall, but drawing 10 shows it lying 6 mm in front of the wall (y344.5-392.5, 228×48 footprint). Drawing position used; alternative y350.5-398.5.

Speaker flange/grille protrude forward of the speaker part front y215 (flange y208, grille face y203) over the end-part rear (key module depth y0..212); fine only because they are above z77 (end-part top ~z59-73).
